title: Sampling trajectories and averaging out the policy
brief: Follow a policy through the hallway MDP to sample episodes, then average the policy away to get the Markov chain P_pi and the expected reward r_pi.
hints: In sample_episode, call mdp.sample(s, a, rng), which returns (next_state, reward). Append the first state before the loop and every next state inside it, so states ends up one longer than actions.
np.einsum('sa,sat->st', pi, mdp.P) averages the transition rows over the policy's actions. The expected reward is (pi * mdp.R).sum(axis=1).
Zero the terminal rows with a mask: live = ~mdp.terminal, then P_pi * live[:, None] and r_pi * live.
